correctness.rationale: The DFS over the directed de Bruijn graph starts with the unique zero edge and visits each unused binary m-gram exactly once in every accepted Eulerian circuit; rooting at its unique zero edge gives each rotation class exactly once, with all windows verified independently. The finite family sizes 1,1,2,16,2048 match the classical de Bruijn formula. Maximal closedness was independently recomputed for all possible substring occurrences using their proper borders and left/right single-character extensions and separately via a suffix-LCP strict-record characterization. Independently authored code traversed all 2048 order-five cycles and reproduced every histogram count; no extrapolation beyond m=5. The weighted sum is 2048*(2957/64) and both extrema have 8 witnesses.

final_claim: The exact histogram of occurrence counts of maximal closed substrings, using unique all-zero cyclic rotation and m−1-symbol extension, is classified for every binary de Bruijn word of order 1<=m<=5. At m=5 all 2048 cycles yield values 40..54 with exact multiplicities (8,16,112,204,252,304,308,264,176,124,108,84,52,28,8), mean 2957/64.
limitations: Only canonical linearization of cyclic de Bruijn words orders 1..5; not invariant under arbitrary cyclic cut, and no m>=6 statement.
